---
title: "Groomer manual"
---

This manual covers the shop app's everyday screens: the Welcome screen, the
Check-in screen, each dog's card, and the Calendar screen. It is written for
every groomer.

Each procedure is numbered and follows the same order: Purpose, Applies to,
Before you begin, Procedure, Result, and If something goes wrong. Carry out
the steps in order.

::: {.callout-note}
## Click or tap
This manual says **click**. On a tablet, tap wherever it says click.
:::

## Procedures in this manual

| Number | Procedure |
|---|---|
| GRM-01 | [Sign in to your profile](signing-in.qmd) |
| GRM-02 | [Check in a dog](checking-in-a-dog.qmd) |
